blocks.text: This glamorous accent table is a true ode to art deco style, featuring a timeless footed base and a raised edge tabletop that exudes both grace and functionality. Perfect for pairing with an accent chair in a living room or bedroom, or anywhere you need to rest a cocktail, this table is ideal for entertaining guests or enjoying a quiet evening at home. Assembling this piece is as effortless as it gets, as no tools are required. Made entirely of metal, this table radiates durability and longevity, while the compact size makes it easy to move from room to room. At 12.5 inches in diameter and 27.5 inches in height, this table is the epitome of versatility, allowing you to savor your favorite cocktail and relish delectable treats without sacrificing valuable space.

items: This art deco-inspired martini table showcases an elegant, footed base and raised edge tabletop for style and security
This table is ideal for use next to an accent chair in a living room, bedroom, or anywhere you may need to rest a martini
Table measures 12.5 inches in diameter x 27.5 inches H; Maximum weight capacity of 11 pounds
